Unified Enterprise Architecture Flow: How the Protocols Interact in Production
Traces an end-to-end request from client login to microservice token exchange and backend storage.
Architectural Cheat Sheet: Core Protocol Decisions at a Glance
SAML 2.0 = Heavy XML, enterprise web browser redirects (Okta, Workday). OIDC = Lightweight JSON/JWT, built for mobile apps, SPAs & modern REST APIs.
OAuth 2.0 is Authorization ONLY (gives a valet key to access resources). OIDC adds the Identity layer on top (OIDC = OAuth 2.0 + ID Token).
One-way TLS authenticates the server only. Mutual TLS (mTLS) cryptographically verifies both client and server certificates at Layer 4 (zero-trust backbone).
JWT is stateless & verifiable locally (trade-off: revocation lag). Opaque is a reference UUID (instant revocation, trade-off: IdP database lookup per call).
